rules.name: Adaptive HD x265
rules.when:
not isAnime
and parsed.codec == "hevc"
and not ("remux" in traits)
and not any(hdr, # == "HDR" or # == "HDR10+" or # == "DV")
and not library
and (
  (
    resolution == "1080p"
    and count(
      resolution == "1080p"
      and parsed.codec == "avc"
      and (
        "remux" in traits
        or "bluray" in traits
        or "webdl" in traits
      )
    ) > 6
  )
  or
  (
    resolution == "720p"
    and count(
      resolution == "720p"
      and parsed.codec == "avc"
      and (
        "bluray" in traits
        or "webdl" in traits
      )
    ) > 6
  )
)

aggregateCases.name: 1080p HEVC retained with six AVC alternatives
1080p HEVC rejected with seven AVC alternatives
720p HEVC rejected with seven 720p AVC alternatives
AV1 is not treated as x265

rules.name: 1080p Remux Preference
rules.when:
(kind == "movie" or kind == "series")
and not isAnime
and resolution == "1080p"
and "remux" in traits
and not library
and count(
  resolution == "2160p"
  and "webdl" in traits
  and not any(hdr, # == "HDR" or # == "HDR10+")
) > 0
and count(
  resolution == "2160p"
  and "webdl" in traits
  and any(hdr, # == "HDR" or # == "HDR10+")
) == 0

aggregateCases.name: Dolby Vision only 2160p WEB-DL keeps Remux preference
HDR option suppresses preference even with SDR option
Dolby Vision with HDR fallback suppresses preference
Show 1080p Remux preferred over SDR 2160p WEB-DL
